thread:
elaine: Heads-up — quick scrub of hero copy for hosted / dedicated / private pages. We need short-form variants optimized for social launch posts and webinar CTAs. Goal: 2 hero lines + 1 supporting sentence each, very scannable. Can everyone drop preferences and any hard constraints?

mike: Sounds good. Can we keep token/latency jargon out of hero (save for subcopy)? simple value props.

elaine: Agreed. Hero should be benefit-led: predictable latency, lower inference cost, secure deployment options. Examples incoming. :sparkles:

jin: For webinar comms, we want a distinct CTA: "See performance in action" vs site CTA "Get started" — map CTAs to inbound routing so webinar clicks go to demo sign-up.

ash: Quick note on flow: hosted pages -> marketing funnel (trial), dedicated -> contact sales, private -> enterprise form + security doc download. We'll need UTM and form variants accordingly.

elaine: Love it. Draft short hero variants — drop 2 each. Will A/B via short social posts.

marketing-bot: Drafts uploaded: https://drive.redwood/drafts/short-hero-scrub-v1 (permission: team-marketing)

mike: Pasting quick variants for each mode:
```
Hosted: "Production-ready inference, minutes to integrate"
Sub: "Low-latency hosted API with predictable pricing and streaming responses."
CTA: "Start free"

Dedicated: "Reserved capacity. Predictable throughput."
Sub: "Dedicated GPU pools with SLAs and autoscaling for steady load."
CTA: "Request reserved capacity"

Private: "Inference in your VPC or on-prem."
Sub: "Full control, audit logs, and KMS/HSM integrations for regulated data."
CTA: "Contact sales"
```

jin: Those read really clean. A couple tweaks: Hosted sub should mention "developer-first SDKs" somewhere, but maybe in the second line. Also make Dedicated CTA shorter: "Request capacity"

elaine: Updated variants look good. Can we try even shorter hero headlines for social cards (8-10 words max)? Eg Hosted: "Ship LLM features with low latency — no ops"

ash: On inbound routing mapping: webinar CTA -> demo flow (assign to solutions.eng), social trial CTA -> self-serve signup, contact sales -> AE queue. I'll add support notes to the playbook.

marketing-bot: Playbook entry updated: https://drive.redwood/playbooks/launch-routing (changes by ash)

mike: One more experiment idea: test a cost-led hero for low-volume startups ("Lower per-token inference cost at scale") vs performance-led. Keep as variant B.

elaine: Good split. We'll run 2-week A/B on landing hero + 1 weekend social blitz. Jin — can webinar slides include a micro-benchmark slide and a single cost chart? Keep it digestible.

jin: Yes — one slide: throughput vs latency + top-line cost delta. I'll craft a simplified chart and a 30s script.

ash: Keeping forms aligned: add hidden field "campaign=hero-ab-test" and route based on CTA. Also tag trials from webinar as "webinar_demo" in CRM.

mike: I'll shorten CTAs in the copy doc. Also adding one-line microcopy under CTAs about privacy for Private page: "Data stays in your network — we don't store inputs."

elaine: Perfect. Next steps: mike to push copy variants to the page draft, jin to prep webinar micro-benchmark slide, ash to update inbound routing & playbook, marketing-bot to schedule A/B test. Check-in Friday for final signoff. :calendar:

marketing-bot: Meeting created: Friday 10:00am weekly-review (invite sent).
